highlights: Standalone Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop app that imports VPro 64 .accdb and .mdb projects directly—no Microsoft Access needed.
Built-in 2026 BC standards (BECdb v13, BCPlantTaxonomy v19 with 16,728 species, and LMH25 (2023) live field checks).
Interactive 3D Map that works offline in the field for BGC v13 and Ecosection checks and selecting plots directly into Site Units.
Live BEC Differential and Pairwise Synthesis that updates immediately as plots move between Site Units and exports a 4-sheet Diagnostic Excel workbook (.xlsx).
Optional R Companion tools for climr climate normals, rSMR/aSMR edatopic grids, candidate plot clustering, and Quarto Site Unit and BGC guides.
Built-in offline F1 LMH25 (2023) field reference, 4 interactive guided tours on the Sample project, and open data exchange (VENUS 5.0, TurboVeg 3, GeoPackage, CSV, and R .rds).
Initial VPro Desktop preview with FS882, Two-Page, and SIVI plot forms, Plot Profiling, and Summary and Long Excel/PDF reports.
